name: Telemetry Relay
description: Sends live telemetry from game instances (player positions, item pickups, match events) to ql-stats-hub through a relay on each host. Set the stats-hub URL and ingest token in Settings, turn the relay on per host (host menu, Telemetry Relay), then switch each instance on from its Telemetry menu entry. The instances need the stream_telemetry_unified plugin.

host_relay.description: Relay sidecar for this host. Enable it to forward telemetry from every instance on this host to the stats-hub target below (falls back to the cluster-wide default when left blank). Saving with Enabled first asks stats-hub to let this host's IP through its firewall; turning the relay off takes the host out again unless the Demo Stream Tunnel is still on. The status shows the sidecar, the hub firewall and when the hub last got telemetry from this host.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Deploys and starts the relay sidecar on this host.

fields.label: Stats-hub URL override
fields.description: Leave blank to use the cluster-wide default.

fields.label: Ingest token override
fields.description: Leave blank to use the cluster-wide default.

instance_telemetry.description: Sends this instance's telemetry to ql-stats-hub through the host relay. Switching it on or off applies the config and restarts the instance; the server ID is reserved automatically and kept when switched off.

fields.label: Send telemetry
fields.description: Needs the Telemetry Relay on this host and the stream_telemetry_unified plugin on the instance.

global_settings.description: Cluster-wide stats-hub target. Individual hosts may override both values.

fields.label: Stats-hub URL
fields.description: Default ql-stats-hub base URL every host's relay forwards to.

fields.label: Ingest token
fields.description: STATS_HUB_INGEST_TOKEN, not STATS_HUB_API_TOKEN. The wrong one fails silently with a 401 that trips the circuit breaker on every feed.
